Healthy.why: Plant appears healthy with no visible disease symptoms.

Early Blight.why: Commonly associated with the fungus Alternaria solani, especially under warm and humid conditions.
Early Blight.risk_conditions: Warm weather, leaf wetness, high humidity and poor air circulation.
solutions: Use appropriate fungicide according to local agricultural guidance.

Late Blight.why: Caused by Phytophthora infestans and favored by cool, wet and humid conditions.
Late Blight.risk_conditions: Cool temperatures, high humidity, rain and prolonged leaf wetness.
solutions: Use appropriate fungicide according to local agricultural guidance.
prevention: Monitor plants frequently during wet weather.

Leaf Mold.why: Fungal disease favored by high humidity and poor air circulation.
Leaf Mold.risk_conditions: High humidity, warm conditions and poor ventilation.
solutions: Use appropriate fungicide according to local agricultural guidance.
